Quper Simulator: сборки карт ETS2 и ATS,: Quper Simulator: ETS2 and ATS map combos, original mods and plugins, videos and a virtual trucking company. The whole world at our wheels!
Фикс генерации грузов для собственного п: Own-trailer cargo generation fix and ETS2 market management.
Плагин уменьшает подтормаживания, связан: The plugin reduces stutters related to generating offers for your own trailer: it limits generation attempts and preserves unexpired offers for the current trailer. The main fix works automatically, without opening the menu or pressing buttons.
Windows x64, DirectX 11. Поддерживаются: Windows x64, DirectX 11. Specific verified EXEs are supported. Unknown builds disable market features and log the reason. An in-headset VR menu has not been implemented yet.
На обложке и в видео показано прежнее уп: The cover and video show the previous F8/F9 controls; the screenshots are from version 0.6.1. In version 0.7.2, Ctrl+Alt+F9 opens or closes the menu. Shortcuts for individual actions are assigned in the menu and disabled by default.
Автоматический фикс генерации предложени: Automatic fix for own-trailer offer generation.
Добавление до пяти новых предложений на: Add up to five new offers per company for your own trailer. The number depends on the availability of suitable cargo.
Три независимых запуска добавления грузо: Three independent cargo-adding uses; each recharges after 48 in-game hours.
Штатная замена предложений рынка грузопе: Standard replacement of Freight Market offers and agency jobs. Another run is available five real-time seconds after the previous one finishes.
Встроенное меню и уведомления на русском: Built-in menu and notifications in Russian and English, with customizable keyboard shortcuts.
Закрой игру. Первый запуск experimental-: Close the game. Use a copy of your profile for the first run of the experimental version.
Помести CargoControlETS2.dll из архива в: Place CargoControlETS2.dll from the archive in Euro Truck Simulator 2/bin/win_x64/plugins. When updating, replace the old DLL and keep only one version of the plugin. It does not need to be added to the Mod Manager.
Запусти игру в режиме DirectX 11. Основн: Start the game in DirectX 11 mode. The main fix works automatically. Press Ctrl+Alt+F9 to open or close the menu.
Горячие клавиши отдельных действий назна: Shortcuts for individual actions are assigned in the menu and disabled by default. Stop the truck before generating cargo.
Статус: experimental. Сборка и 12 офлайн: Status: experimental. The build and 12 offline checks passed; in-game testing is still required. Use a copy of your profile for the first run. The plugin affects market generation and does not address all possible causes of stuttering.
Кнопки меню и уведомления получили зелён: Menu buttons and notifications use the green accent #6FD34B. Buttons brighten on hover while retaining saturation.
Рынок грузоперевозок и заказы агентств м: Refresh the Freight Market and Quick Jobs from the garage without owning a truck or selecting Drive. The plugin prompts you if the profile is still loading or you need to select an owned trailer to add cargo. The new green accent is #9DDD8C.
Одна DLL поддерживает обычную 1.61.1.9,: One DLL supports standard 1.61.1.9, temporary 1.61.1.1s, Oculus 1.61.1.1009s, and public beta 1.62.0.10s. The plugin selects a profile based on the exact game build.
Мышь в меню использует относительный вво: The menu uses relative DirectInput mouse movement to keep the cursor from getting stuck at the center. While the menu is open, it captures mouse input through this path.
Меню и уведомления отрисовываются через: DirectX 11 renders the menu and notifications in-game. While the menu is open, the result notification is hidden and its timer pauses.
Меню оформлено в чёрном, белом и зелёном: The menu uses black, white, and green with the brand logo. Result notifications stay visible for seven seconds of reading time. The timer pauses when the game loses focus.
Ctrl+Alt+F9 открывает меню с кнопками «Д: Ctrl+Alt+F9 opens a menu with Add Cargo and Refresh Jobs buttons. Both actions support custom shortcuts, disabled by default.
Квоту в три запуска для F9 убрали. Следу: The three-use quota for F9 was removed. Another refresh is available five real-time seconds after the previous one finishes.
Убрали порог в 10 000 компаний, из-за ко: Removed the 10,000-company threshold that could cause manual generation to stop silently. The game log now records key presses, pause state, and company count.
Уведомления получили логотип Quper Simul: Notifications gained the Quper Simulator logo and brand colors. The logo is embedded in the DLL.
F9 запускает штатное обновление предложе: F9 uses the game's standard company job refresh. New jobs replace old ones, with the count depending on the company and map.
Обновление рынка и заказов агентств: Freight Market and Quick Jobs refresh
Добавлен второй режим по F9. Выпуск отоз: A second mode was added on F9. The release was withdrawn after creating extra job slots was found to cause a crash.
У каждого из трёх запусков появился свой: Each of the three uses gets its own 48 in-game hour timer. A run that generates no new offers does not use a slot.
Добавлен контроль автоматической генерац: Added control over automatic cargo generation for owned trailers. F8 added up to five new offers per company while keeping existing jobs. The limit was three successful runs per 20 real-time minutes. Results appeared on screen and in the game log.
